intent_contract.method_intent: Rebalance unequal DROID action dimensions before they enter Cosmos3 forward-dynamics conditioning.
intent_contract.target_behavior: Compute bounded inverse-RMS gains from the declared training-side action frame and apply them only to the H2 action JSON consumed by inference.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace per-dimension gains with global action scaling.
Do not alter GT future frames, evaluator outputs, or held-out split membership.
verification_requirements: Disabled or zero-blend behavior preserves action values.
The hook receipt records shape, gains, source hash, and transformed hash.

intent_contract.method_intent: Reinject a stable first-frame visual anchor during long autoregressive forward-dynamics rollout.
intent_contract.target_behavior: Blend the original conditioning latent at declared chunk boundaries while leaving action chunks and GT targets unchanged.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not substitute ordinary last-frame chaining or video post-processing for a first-frame latent anchor.
verification_requirements: A runtime test must show original-frame latent use at the configured interval and exact identity when disabled.

intent_contract.method_intent: Schedule classifier-free guidance over Cosmos3 denoising steps.
intent_contract.target_behavior: Expose step-indexed guidance at the H4 sampler callback instead of replacing it with one constant scalar.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not claim the existing constant guidance argument as a guidance schedule.
verification_requirements: Sampler traces must record both endpoints and at least two distinct applied guidance values.

intent_contract.method_intent: Increase exposure to diagnosed DROID failure-frontier windows without changing labels.
intent_contract.target_behavior: Apply auditable sampler weights only on the training split at H1.
forbidden_substitutions: Do not duplicate accept windows, alter evaluator identities, or convert sampling weight into loss weight.
verification_requirements: Sampler receipts report intended and realized mixture proportions with split isolation.
